content.title: Coachella 2026 Lineup & Schedule: See Every Performer Set Time for Weekend 2 Here
content.text: Weekend one of Coachella 2026 was one for the books, but if you missed any performances, fret not, because we still have weekend two. If you are frantically looking for the Coachella 2026 lineup and schedule for weekend two to plan your festival itinerary or watch party, then you've come to the right place—because, yes, some timeframes do change for weekend two, and some artists are replaced or move to different days!The headliners of Coachella 2026 are again Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, and Karol G. They pick up the baton from last year's headliners, Lady Gaga, Green Day, and Post Malone. Italian DJ Anyma will also have a special stage during the 2026 festival, premiering the project ÆDEN. Though originally slated for weekend one, he had to cancel his performance due to the strong winds on site. But fret not, because he will be back for weekend two and, by the looks of it, with plenty of special guests.Courtesy of CoachellaAside from the headliners, there are plenty of other acts that should be on your radar for Coachella 2026, including Teen Vogue cover stars KATSEYE, anime soundtrackers Creepy Nuts, K-pop royalty Taemin and BIGBANG, as well as The Strokes, Addison Rae, Laufey, and countless more. Check out the full Coachella 2026 lineup and exactly when each act will perform during weekend two, broken down by day below.Friday dates (April 10 & 17)Mike Coppola/Getty ImagesSabrina Carpenter serves as the headliner on both Fridays at Coachella. Following a major festival run last year, performing at anywhere from Primavera Sound to BST Hyde Park, she made her return to Coachella as a headliner with a star-studded performance inspired by Hollywood life. The star made her Coachella debut on the main stage in the early hours of the afternoon in 2024, fresh off the release of her hit single “Espresso.” For her first headlining set during weekend one, Carpenter gave us special appearances from Susan Sarandon, her bestie Corey Fogelmanis, Will Ferrell, Sam Elliott, and even Samuel L. Jackson. Who will she bring out during weekend two? We'd better tune in to see!For weekend two, Sabrina Carpenter is expected to take the Coachella main stage at 9:00 p.m. PT.KATSEYE — 8:00 p.m. PT at the Sahara stageEthel Cain — 10:45 p.m. PT at the Sahara stageDijon — 6:40 p.m. PT at the Outdoor Theatre stageTeddy Swims — 5:20 p.m. PT at the Coachella main stageCentral Cee — 5:30 p.m. PT at the Mojave stageBINI — 4:15 p.m. PT at the Mojave stageCMAT — 6:15 p.m. PT at the Gobi stageCreepy Nuts — 11:05 p.m. PT at the Gobi stageSwae Lee — 10:50 p.m. PT at the Sahara stageSexyy Red — 12:05 a.m. PT at the Sahara stageAnyma — 12:00 a.m. PT at the Coachella main stageMore acts: The XX, Jacqck Glam, Disclosure, Turnstile, Lykke Li, Dabeull, Jeremiah Red, Hot Mulligan, Cachirula & Loojan, Ninajirachi, The Two Lips, Fleshwater, Wednesday, Carolina Durante, Febuary, Jim Smith, Joost, Holly Humberstone, fakemink, Joyce Manor, NewDad, Bob Baker Marionettes, Cahuilla Bird Singers and Dancers, Blood Orange, Moby, Devo, Slayyyter, El Ethos, Levity, Marlon Hoffstadt, HUGEL, Youna, Bad Gal Gali, Gordo, Max Styler, Max Dean x Luke Dean, Prospa, Kettama, Chloé Caillet x Rossi., Groove Armada, Arodes, Jessica Brankka, Sahar Z, Armin van Buuren x Adam Beyer, Franky Rizardo, and Darco.Saturday dates (April 11 & 18)Cassy Athena/Getty ImagesJustin Bieber serves as the headliner for the Saturday dates. Despite being an avid attendee, Coachella 2026 marks Justin Bieber's first-ever headlining set at the famed festival—and his first time on the festival lineup, too. Though Bieber has appeared as a guest during other artists' sets, he has never graced a Coachella stage as part of the official slate. Bieber released Swag and Swag II in 2025, and the projects served as the backbone for his weekend one performance, which was rounded off with a YouTube singalong session of his older music, from “Baby” to “Sorry.” Bieber brought out The Kid Laroi, Dijon, Tems, Wizkid, and Mk.gee during weekend one.For weekend two, Justin Bieber is also expected to take the Coachella main stage at 11:25 p.m. PT.Addison Rae — 5:25 p.m. PT at the Coachella stageLabrinth — 8:30 p.m. PT at the Outdoor Theatre stageSOMBR — 7:05 p.m. PT at the Outdoor Theatre stageGIVEON — 7:00 p.m. PT at the Coachella stageRoyel Otis — 5:50 p.m. PT at the Mojave stageTaemin — 7:30 p.m. PT at the Mojave stagePinkPantheress — 8:55 p.m. PT at the Mojave stagerusowsky — 6:40 p.m. PT at the Sonora stageThe Strokes — 9:00 p.m. PT at the Coachella stageKacey Musgraves — 3:o0 p.m. PT at the Mojave stageMore acts: Record Safari, David Byrne, AlexG, Los Hermanos Flores, Blondshell, Mind Enterprises, 54 Ultra, Ceremony, Ecca Vandal, Freak Slug, Die Spitz, Buster Jarvis, Morat, BIA, Davido, Geese, Luísa Sonza, WHATMORE, Noga Erez, Interpol, Fujii Kaze, Worship, Adriatique, Nine Inch Noize, ¥ØU$UK€ ¥UK1MAT$U, Hamdi, ZULAN, TEED, Fundido, Armin van Buuren x Adam Beyer, Boys Noize, Bedouin, SOSA, Ben Sterling, Mahmut Orhan, Riordan, GENESI, Yamagucci, DJ Snake x Knock2, DJ Snake x RL Grime x Flosstradamus, Madeon, and Devault.Sunday dates (April 12 & 19)Buda Mendes/Getty ImagesKarol G serves as the headliner on Sunday. Much like Carpenter, Coachella 2026 marks Karol G's sophomore appearance at Indio, having made her Coachella debut in 2022. The Colombian star makes history as the first Latina woman to serve as a Coachella headliner. Though her set was delayed, it was worth the wait. Karol G performed multiple tracks from Tropicoqueta and Mañana Será Bonito, as well as hit singles such as “Tusa” and “Si Antes Te Hubiera Conocido.” The star also covered classic Latin songs and even debuted new tracks. Her guests for weekend one included Wisin, Becky G, Mariah Angeliq, and Greg Gonzalez of Cigarettes After SexFor weekend two, Karol G is expected to take the Coachella main stage at 10:10 p.m. PT.BIGBANG — 10:30 p.m. PT at the Outdoor Theatre stageLaufey — 8:45 p.m. PT at the Outdoor Theatre stageYoung Thug — 7:50 p.m. PT at the Coachella main stageMajor Lazer — 6:10 p.m. PT at the Coachella main stageFKA twigs — 8:45 p.m. PT at the Mojave stageWet Leg — 4:45 p.m. PT at the Coachella main stageLittle Simz — 4:25 p.m. PT at the Mojave stageMore acts: Tijuana Panthers, Gabe Real, Foster the People, Clipse, Gigi Perez, Juicewon, French Police, DRAIN, RØZ, Los Retros, Jane Remover, Model/Actriz, Glitterer, Bulletballet, The Rapture, Tomora, Black Flag, Oklou, COBRAH, The Chats, flowerovlove, Iggy Pop, Suicidal Tendencies, Samia, Megatone, Kaskade, Subtronics, Mochakk, Duke Dumont, BUNT., Girl Math, Gingee, Green Velvet × AYYBO, WhoMadeWho, Röyksopp, Carlita x Josh Baker, MËSTIZA, &friends, AZZECCA, LE YORA, Sara Landry's Blood Oath, LP Giobbi, and Linska.Check out the full schedules for Friday, Saturday, and Sunday of weekend one of Coachella 2026 below:~This\ post\ has\ been\ updated\ to\ reflect\ specific\ timings\ for\ weekend\ two.\ If\ you\ want\ to\ cross-reference,\ you\ can\ find\ the\ weekend\ one\ schedule\ here.~
